description: This PHP script functions as an AJAX tree loader for navigating requirements and related nodes in the TestLink project. It retrieves hierarchical data from the database, constructs a JSON structure for client-side rendering, and handles different node types such as test projects, requirement specs, and requirements.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class used to manage hierarchical node types and retrieve node information.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a list of child nodes for a given parent node, applying filters and node type logic, and returns the data as an array suitable for JSON encoding.
